descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S08 「字段有或没有 × 模式 → 和照片上一样的值，或留空（绝不编造）」 Field present or absent × context → value as on the photo, or blank (never invented)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 6；TFA-92580 How it works 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92580 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Lists whose cells or columns are missing on purpose

When Each is read by scanCensusSheet

Then MRN column absent → mrn blank on every row. Room/unit cell empty → blank. Diagnosis empty → blank. DOB absent → blank. Age empty → blank. No admit-date column → admit_date blank. No hospital-day column → day_num blank. Every field that is present comes back exactly as on the photo, in both contexts

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Decision table, cell by cell, against the truth JSON. Compare the raw scanCensusSheet rows after cleanScannedName/isLikelyPatientRow (Hospital) or extractedResidents (Nursing Home), never after buildScannedPatient/submitScan, which turn blanks into '—', dayNum 1, today's admitDate and SNF-######. Blank means '', 0, null or missing, so day_num 0 is blank, not invented. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
